Sandbox_RemoveLimits_CharacterMode_toolt: Controls both the displayed character carry capacity and the inventory pickup limit. Unlimited uses a practical limit of 10000.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_CharacterCapacityLi: Displayed carry capacity and maximum character inventory weight when Character inventory capacity is set to Custom limit.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_ContainerMode_toolt: Choose vanilla capacity, multiply each container's original capacity, or remove the capacity limit.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_ContainerMultiplier: Applied when Container capacity is set to Multiplier. The original capacity and Organized/Disorganized effects are preserved.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_AffectBags_tooltip: Apply the container mode to carried and stored bags.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_AffectWorldContaine: Apply the container mode to cupboards, crates, furniture, corpses, and other world containers. Floor item safety remains vanilla.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_AffectVehicles_tool: Apply the container mode to trunks, glove boxes, seats, and bags stored in vehicles.
Sandbox_RemoveLimits_IgnoreVehicleCargoM: Vehicle cargo does not add mass
When enabled, items stored in vehicle containers do not increase the vehicle's physics mass. Installed vehicle parts still count.
